decisions.reason: The waste oil to energy plant builds on established capabilities and stays a core option, but its absence from the website in 2020–2021 suggests uncertainty is resolving less favorably, so the risk of withdrawal is moderate.

Four years after launch, the plastic-to-fuel plant has not shown on the website that its high but uncertain value is being realized, and such plants are often uneconomic, so the firm with many other venture options should abandon it and redeploy the resources.
